notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionists enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least fifteen Treasure tokens.
Activate fourteen Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
